title: One Car Photo Three Sizes
tests: Tests delivering three distinct aspect-ratio adaptations of one source while keeping the complete subject in every version.

faults.what: The 4:5 feed crop cuts off the rear end of the car at the right edge.
The 9:16 stories crop cuts off both ends of the car, including the front wheel, rather than using padding to preserve the whole vehicle.

judge.summary: Three separate, correctly proportioned frames were delivered, but the feed and stories crops fail to keep the complete car visible.

must_haves.item: Three separate images are delivered, rather than one collage.
must_haves.why: There are three distinct output images.

must_haves.item: The three frames have ratios of 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 respectively.
must_haves.why: The square, feed and stories frames visibly match the requested aspect ratios.

must_haves.item: Every version shows the same red hatchback from the attached photo.
must_haves.why: All three outputs show crops of the original red hatchback photo.

must_haves.item: The complete car, including roof, wheels and both ends, is visible in every version.
must_haves.why: Only the square version preserves the whole car; the feed clips the rear, and the stories version clips both ends and excludes the front wheel.

must_haves.item: The car retains its original proportions and appearance in all versions.
must_haves.why: The visible car details retain the source appearance and proportions without evident stretching or alteration.

must_haves.item: Any padding is a blurred version of the source photo, and no version contains added text.
must_haves.why: No padding or added text is present.
